decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Incubation / Incongruity and Living End, then cast Living End to bring back all of those creatures onto the battlefield for a massive swing. The deck also includes a mix of creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects, like Bloodbraid Marauder and Territorial Kavu, to further capitalize on the graveyard recursion strategy. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help protect the combo pieces, while Malevolent Rumble and Scion of Draco provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's board.

The main concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to generate a high amount of mana through rituals and mana-producing spells, while also utilizing card draw and filtering effects to find combo pieces quickly. The deck aims to cast multiple spells in a single turn, eventually leading to a big finish with cards like Past in Flames or Wish. The goal is to set up a powerful storm turn where the player can play multiple spells for a game-winning combination, starring cards like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to flood the board with cheap artifacts and efficiently use mana to power out threats quickly. By utilizing cards like Thoughtcast and Springleaf Drum, the deck aims to draw into key pieces like Cranial Plating and Thought Monitor to boost its creatures and maintain card advantage. The various artifact creatures and artifacts in the deck also synergize well with the affinity mechanic, allowing for explosive turns and overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on using a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls to provide support and buffs to your creatures. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory can help finish off the opponent once you have established board control. In addition, cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment can disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, using cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, to then cast Living End and bring them all back onto the battlefield. It also includes counter spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo and disruption cards like Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's hand. The creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves help to pressure the opponent and close out the game once the Living End combo is set up. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Unearth and Persist to bring back large threatening creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty from the graveyard. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence, while also having the flexibility to disrupt their strategy. Lastly, it includes a small toolbox of versatile creatures like Psychic Frog and Troll of Khazad-dûm to handle various situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing mana ramp with Birthing Ritual to quickly cast powerful creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Shardless Agent. It also includes disruptive spells like Flare of Denial and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's board. The deck has a strong Simic theme with cards like Ice-Fang Coatl and Coiling Oracle providing card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation help protect the player's creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cori-Steel Cutter, then supporting them with spells like Mutagenic Growth and Lightning Bolt to push through damage and control the board. The deck also includes card selection and filtering with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to ensure a steady stream of threats. With a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements such as Ugin, Karn, and Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect itself. The deck also includes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Sire of Seven Deaths to apply pressure and close out the game. With a mix of removal, disruption, and mana acceleration, the deck aims to overpower the opponent and establish dominance on the battlefield.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Counterspell while also applying pressure with creatures like Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes card advantage and card selection tools like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Preordain to stay ahead in the long game. The inclusion of removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict help to deal with threats on the board, while cards like Psychic Frog and Subtlety provide additional ways to answer opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure a victory through careful manipulation of resources.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while using cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and dig for more threats. The deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, utilizing its low mana curve and powerful synergy between creatures and spells to take control of the game early on.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls alongside burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds additional firepower and flexibility to the deck. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to consistently apply pressure on opponents and close out games quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Key cards include Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls for early aggression, while Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide direct damage. The deck also features a mix of creature pump spells like Ocelot Pride and removal spells like Thraben Charm to maintain board control. Additionally, Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory offer powerful late-game threats, supported by Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for an extra boost in damage output.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt your opponent's hand and board state using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command. The deck also includes powerful aggressive creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Nethergoyf to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to maintain control of the game through disruptive spells and efficient creatures, while also using lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Eldrazi Temple to generate additional mana for powerful plays.

The Golgari Aggro deck focuses on a fast and disruptive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Nethergoyf to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes cards like Abrupt Decay and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining efficient removal spells with strong creatures and graveyard recursion options, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board presence throughout the game. Overall, the deck emphasizes speed, disruption, and resource management to secure victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizing burn spells for direct damage to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, as well as burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off opponents. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Thraben Charm provide support and utility to the deck, while cards like Voice of Victory and Ocelot Pride boost the deck's overall aggression and power. The deck aims to win quickly through aggressive creature attacks and burn damage.
